test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight friends are sitting around a circular table at equal distances with their back towards the centre of the table. Ishin is sitting to the immediate right of Anshu. Amina is is not an immediate neighbour of Dhruv. Only three people sit between Harmeet and Fiza. Dhruv is to the immediate left of Varun. There are only two people between Mohit and Harmeet. Fiza is sitting to the immediate left of Anshu. Only three people sit between Ishin and Varun. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Harmeet?
solution:
Eight friends are sitting around a circular table at equal distances with their back towards the centre of the table. 

1. Ishin is sitting to the immediate right of Anshu. 

2. Only three people sit between Ishin and Varun.

3. Fiza is sitting to the immediate left of Anshu. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7c165d6478f8888bb78d40c51f925ea71310194aa0d88a303728878e98154ab.png] 

4. Dhruv is to the immediate left of Varun.

5. Amina is is not an immediate neighbour of Dhruv. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7cdac1a2ea6f88e099b402cca48ff575c9b00c16134d9c5bc8996891f148c8b.png] 

6. Only three people sit between Harmeet and Fiza. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bde19985ba6ddbdbd6e9d7b1514e6bd3fb4704e268dec6a9fcc0322010450d2.png] 

7. There are only two people between Mohit and Harmeet. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b95382949bcc41b4f78026f769b513cde29ab880adbb20cc7b04945429c2aaf.png] 

The vacant position will be occupied by the only left person Amina.

Therefore, the final arrangement will be as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a252fccfc8a43d366a060a32a1a1b852137e8351fd8c6478b719244b62d9e9e.png] 

Clearly, Amina is sitting to the immediate left of Harmeet.

Hence, '**Amina**' is the correct answer.
